site.name: stratabox
site.summary: stratabox-clone Fictional headless content platform "Stratabox" marketing site (Contentful / Sanity-style). Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Single-page long scroll: sticky top nav; hero with editor-vs-live-preview split panel that periodically swaps blocks; trusted-by logo strip; 4-stat row with intersection-observer count-up; 3 feature cards; **live block builder** (drag-and-drop reorder, type switcher, add/delete blocks, two-pane editor + render with debounced auto-save status); 4-language SDK code tabs (JS / Python / Ruby / curl) with copy button; 24-card searchable integrations grid; 3 customer quotes; gradient pricing teaser; dark 4-column footer | | `styles.css` | Brand color #0E7E7E warm teal + cream paper; Inter + JetBrains Mono; responsive at 3 breakpoints (>1100 / 720–1100 / <720) | | `script.js` | Stat count-up via IntersectionObserver; hero block-swap micro-animation every 3.5s; full builder logic (reorder via HTML5 drag-and-drop, type switcher, add/delete, debounced auto-save status); SDK tab switcher with syntax-highlighted snippets and copy-to-clipboard toast; integrations search filter (matches name + category) with live count |

run_plan.goal: Evaluate the UX of the Stratabox single-page marketing site, focusing on the interactive 'Live Block Builder' demo, SDK documentation usability, and mobile responsiveness of complex UI elements.
run_plan.summary: The run will treat index.html as a multi-section application. It begins with global navigation and hero validation, moves to deep interaction testing of the drag-and-drop content builder, verifies the developer-facing SDK tabs and search filters, and concludes with a rigorous mobile viewport check to address known tap-target risks.
assumptions: The site is a Single Page Application (SPA) style landing page where 'Pricing', 'Product', etc., are scroll anchors rather than separate HTML files.
The 'Start free' and 'Sign in' buttons likely trigger modals or external redirects not fully captured in the static prescan.
The 'Live Block Builder' relies on client-side JS for state management (drag-and-drop, auto-save simulation).
risk_hotspots: Builder Drag-and-Drop: HTML5 DnD often fails on touch devices or has poor accessibility.
SDK Copy Buttons: Clipboard API permissions can fail silently in local file contexts.
Mobile Navigation: Prescan indicates numerous small tap targets (<44px) in the header and builder controls.
Integrations Search: Live filtering logic may have edge cases with special characters or empty states.

phases.title: Global Nav & Hero Validation
phases.objective: Verify sticky header behavior, smooth scrolling to anchors, and initial hero state.
key_checks: Click each nav link (Product, Builder, SDKs, Pricing) to verify scroll-to-anchor behavior.
Validate 'Start free' and 'Book a demo' CTA visibility and hover states.
Observe the hero 'editor-vs-live-preview' split panel for the periodic block-swap animation.
exit_criteria: All nav links scroll to correct sections.
Hero animation cycles at least once.

phases.title: Interactive Builder Stress Test
phases.objective: Deeply exercise the 'Live Block Builder' demo to validate drag-and-drop, editing, and state feedback.
key_checks: Drag a block (e.g., 'Callout') to reorder it; verify visual drop indicator and final position.
Type into the 'New section heading' input; verify real-time update in the Live Preview pane.
Click '+ Paragraph' or '+ Image' to add a new block; verify it appears in both panes.
Wait for the 'debounced auto-save' status indicator to update (e.g., 'saved' vs 'saving').
exit_criteria: Successful reordering of at least 2 blocks.

phases.title: Developer Experience (SDKs & Integrations)
phases.objective: Validate the usability of code snippets and the integrations discovery flow.
key_checks: Switch between SDK tabs (JS, Python, Ruby, curl); verify syntax highlighting updates.
Click the 'Copy' button on a snippet; check for toast notification or visual feedback.
Type a query in the 'Search 24 visible integrations' input; verify grid filtering and count update.
Clear the search input; verify all integrations return.
exit_criteria: Search filter successfully hid non-matching items.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks on mobile viewport to address prescan warnings about small tap targets.
key_checks: Attempt to use the Builder drag-and-drop on touch/mobile emulation (high risk of failure).
Check if the sticky nav collapses into a hamburger menu or remains usable.
Verify text readability in the split-pane editor on narrow screens.
exit_criteria: Builder usability assessment completed (even if unusable, that is a finding).

coverage_targets.pages: 100% of index.html sections (Hero, Builder, SDKs, Integrations, Footer)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all builder controls (add, delete, reorder, edit) and all SDK tabs
coverage_targets.mobile: Full pass on mobile viewport for layout integrity and touch targets

notes: Prescan identified ~10 small tap targets in the header and builder controls; prioritize checking these in Phase 4.
Since this is a local file system run, clipboard permissions for the 'Copy' button might be restricted by the browser; note if this prevents testing.
The 'Pricing' section is described as a 'teaser' in the summary; verify if it links out or expands.

Start free → Book a demo ✔ 50 GB asset CDN free ✔ SOC 2 Type II ✔ EU + US regions studio.stratabox.dev / articles / coastal-bloom EDITOR ● saved H1 Coastal Bloom Returns ¶ Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… ▦ Gallery · 8 images ▣ hero-coast-2026.jpg · 4096×2304 ★ Callout · Tickets on sale May 22 ¶ After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… LIVE PREVIEW web · mobile · email Coastal Bloom Returns After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… hero-coast-2026.jpg ★ Tickets on sale May 22 Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… IN PRODUCTION AT Halcyon Northwind Atlas Bicycle Vesper Wine Riverbed Pinecrest Public Radio Holm & Brock Studio Nephele 2,400+ teams shipping content 99.99% trailing-90d API uptime 42ms p50 read latency 74 locales supported out of the box Platform Built around composable blocks. Editors compose pages from typed blocks. Developers consume the same blocks through a typed API. The platform handles versioning, scheduling, localization, previews, and asset delivery. ▣ Composable schema Define content types and blocks with a visual schema editor or by committing a schema.tb file. Migrations are diffed, reviewed, and rolled back per environment. Typed references & embeds Per-field localization Backward-compatible deprecations ⟳ Real-time collaboration Multi-cursor editing on every block. Suggestions, threads, and assignment live alongside the content. Conflict-free at the field level. Per-block presence Inline review & approval Slack, Linear, Jira mirrors ⚡ Edge content API Read your content from 280 edge POPs with stale-while-revalidate. A headless content platform where editors author with composable blocks, developers query a typed GraphQL+REST API, and your team ships content to web, mobile, kiosks, and email — from a single source of truth. Start free → Book a demo ✔ 50 GB asset CDN free ✔ SOC 2 Type II ✔ EU + US regions studio.stratabox.dev / articles / coastal-bloom EDITOR ● saved H1 Coastal Bloom Returns ¶ Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… ¶ After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… ▣ hero-coast-2026.jpg · 4096×2304 ★ Callout · Tickets on sale May 22 ▦ Gallery · 8 images LIVE PREVIEW web · mobile · email Coastal Bloom Returns After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… hero-coast-2026.jpg ★ Tickets on sale May 22 Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… IN PRODUCTION AT Halcyon Northwind Atlas Bicycle Vesper Wine Riverbed Pinecrest Public Radio Holm & Brock Studio Nephele 2,400+ teams shipping content 99.99% trailing-90d API uptime 42ms p50 read latency 74 locales supported out of the box Platform Built around composable blocks. Editors compose pages from typed blocks. Developers consume the same blocks through a typed API. The platform handles versioning, scheduling, localization, previews, and asset delivery. ▣ Composable schema Define content types and blocks with a visual schema editor or by committing a schema.tb file. Migrations are diffed, reviewed, and rolled back per environment. Typed references & embeds Per-field localization Backward-compatible deprecations ⟳ Real-time collaboration Multi-cursor editing on every block. Suggestions, threads, and assignment live alongside the content. Conflict-free at the field level. Per-block presence Inline review & approval Slack, Linear, Jira mirrors ⚡ Edge content API Read your content from 280 edge POPs with stale-while-revalidate. GraphQL, REST, and a typed JS/TS client are all generated from the same schema. Per-environment tokens Preview & production fork Stable webhooks & replay Studio Drag, drop, ship. observation.visible_text: Stratabox Sign in Start free v8 · Stratabox Studio Structured content for every surface. A headless content platform where editors author with composable blocks, developers query a typed GraphQL+REST API, and your team ships content to web, mobile, kiosks, and email — from a single source of truth. Start free → Book a demo ✔ 50 GB asset CDN free ✔ SOC 2 Type II ✔ EU + US regions studio.stratabox.dev / articles / coastal-bloom EDITOR ● saved H1 Coastal Bloom Returns ¶ Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… ¶ After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… ★ Callout · Tickets on sale May 22 ▦ Gallery · 8 images ▣ hero-coast-2026.jpg · 4096×2304 LIVE PREVIEW web · mobile · email Coastal Bloom Returns After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… hero-coast-2026.jpg ★ Tickets on sale May 22 Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… IN PRODUCTION AT Halcyon Northwind Atlas Bicycle Vesper Wine Riverbed Pinecrest Public Radio Holm & Brock Studio Nephele 0+ teams shipping content 0% trailing-90d API uptime 0ms p50 read latency 0 locales supported out of the box Platform Built around composable blocks. The platform handles versioning, scheduling, localization, previews, and asset delivery. ▣ Composable schema Define content types and blocks with a visual schema editor or by committing a schema.tb file. Migrations are diffed, reviewed, and rolled back per environment.
